shared_elements: figure with arms/hands rendered on the body surface
low-relief carving of a single dominant figure
justification: Both surfaces present a single dominant anthropomorphic figure with a marked headdress and incised circular/disc motifs on the body or field, which is about as generic as figural iconography gets. They differ fundamentally in everything specific: A is a frontal, blocky, heavily schematic figure with arms folded over a belted torso and abstract discs, while B shows a bearded winged genius in strict profile, striding with raised arm holding a cone toward a stylized rosette-bearing plant, rendered with dense, fine linear detailing of feathers, hair and fringe.
